title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. 
 is investing in your next step.





How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Insurance Virtual Assistant + Appointment Setter — US Health & Life Agency (Long-Term, $800-$1,000/mo)
description:
Lead generation, appointment setting, and documentation for a US-based licensed insurance agent. Long-term seat, full-time, US night shift from Manila. ($800-$1,000/mo)



Read this whole post before you apply. I auto-delete applications that skip the steps at the bottom.



I'm a US-based licensed health and life insurance agent in Tampa, Florida. I run my own agency. I'm hiring ONE long-term virtual assistant and appointment setter to become my right hand. I'm not hiring for a month. I'm hiring someone I'll build with for years.



I generate more hot leads every week than I can call alone. Right now most of them go cold because I'm one person. That ends when I hire you. Your job is to call my leads, qualify them, and book them onto my calendar so I can do what I do best — talk to people who are ready to buy.



You will NOT sell anything. You will NOT quote prices. You will NOT explain insurance plans. I am the licensed advisor and I handle all of that. Your job is the phone, the booking, the notes, and the follow-up. Everything that happens before I get on the call is on you.



What you'll do every shift



1. Call my "yes" leads — people who already said they want coverage. You call the newest ones first.

2. Call new leads within 5 minutes of them landing in my system.

3. Call older leads that have gone cold and re-open them.

4. Run my discovery script on every call. I give you the exact words.

5. Qualify the lead with a few simple questions, then book them onto my Google Calendar.

6. Look up a lead's public options on a free public website before I call, and drop your notes into my system.

7. Send follow-up text messages and leave voi
s on people who don't pick up.

8. Update my CRM (Podio) and my dialer (Ringy) after every single call.

9. Keep my lead tracker, pipeline tracker, and revenue tracker spreadsheets current.

10. Send confirmation texts to everyone scheduled for the day.

11. Work the no-answer pile every shift — at least 10 attempts before a lead is marked dead.

12. Send me an end-of-shift report so it's waiting in my inbox when I wake up.



What you will NEVER do



- You never quote a rate or a price.

- You never pitch or explain a product.

- You never answer "how much does it cost" — you book the appointment instead.

- You never ask about someone's health, medications, or conditions over text. Phone only.

- You never use the words "guaranteed," "best," or "cheapest."



I train you on the exact handoff line for every one of these. It's simple and you'll have it memorized in your first week.



The phone setup — no personal phone needed



You dial through my software using my logins, from your browser. My US phone number shows up on the caller ID, so every prospect thinks they're getting a call from the States. All calls record under my account. You need a stable computer, a USB headset, and reliable internet. That's it. No personal phone, no SIM card, no phone bill.



The two tools you'll dial through are Sales God (my main dialer) and Ringy (my CRM dialer). Browser-based, both of them. If you've used Five9, Aircall, JustCall, Mojo, CallTools, or Ringy before, you'll feel at home fast.



The English standard — this is the #1 thing I screen for



My prospects are American. When you call them, they cannot be able to tell you're not calling from inside the US. Your accent has to be clean and neutral. This is the single most important requirement in this post. If your spoken English has a heavy accent, this role isn't the right fit — and the voice recording step below is exactly how I check.



I'm not being unkind about it. I'm being clear so you don't spend time applying for something that won't match. Plenty of Filipino VAs have a neutral, American-sounding phone voice. If that's you, I want to talk.



The schedule



- Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 7 PM Eastern Standard Time.

- That's 10 PM to 7 AM Manila time.

- Full-time, 40 hours a week.

- You must already have experience working the US night shift from the Philippines. If you've never done graveyard shift for a US client, this will be a rough fit and I'll know within a week.



The pay



- Base pay is $800 to $1,000 USD per month, depending on your experience and how the trial week goes.

- Paid weekly through Wise.

- Performance bonuses may be available after proven long-term performance is demonstrated. I reward people who earn it over time. I don't promise bonus money on day one.



Who I'm looking for



- 1+ year of solid history on OnlineJobs.ph with real reviews.

- Prior phone experience with a US company — insurance, real estate, SaaS, or call-center appointment setting.

- Experience dialing through a browser-based system tied to a client's account.

- A neutral, American-sounding phone voice.

- Someone who wants ONE long-term home, not five clients at once. If you're juggling multiple clients, we're not a fit. I want your focus.

- Reliable, self-managing, and honest. I have to trust your reports.



How to apply — three steps. Skip one and I delete it.



I'm going to get a lot of applications. These three steps tell me who actually reads and follows instructions. That's the job, so this is the test.



1. Use this exact subject line: **Tampa Setter**

   (If your subject line is anything else, I won't open it.)



2. Record a 60-second voice clip on 
 reading the short script below out loud, exactly as written. Paste the Vocaroo link in your application. This is how I judge your phone voice, so record it like you're actually on a call — warm, clear, confident.



3. In two or three sentences, tell me: the longest US night-shift role you've held, and what browser dialers/CRM tools you've used. Be specific. Name the tools.



The script to read for your voice recording



> "Hi, is this [first name]? Hey [first name], this is Heather. You recently responded yes to a text from us about exploring your health coverage options — is that right? Awesome. I'm not here to sell you anything or quote you a price on this call. My only job is to ask you a couple quick questions and get you booked with my senior advisor Ryan, who walks you through the actual details. Do you have just two minutes for me right now?"



That's it. Subject line, voice clip, two-sentence note. Applications that follow all three steps go to the top of my list.



I read every complete application personally. If you're the right person, this is a stable, long-term seat with an owner who'll invest in you. I'm looking forward to hearing your voice.



— Ryan Kucks, Kucks Health LLC, Tampa FL

title: Senior Operations Lead / Head of Operations
description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Operations Lead / Head of Operations for our DTC e-commerce business.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can bring structure, accountability, and execution across daily operations. 

The goal is to make the business more organized, improve operational visibility, reduce founder dependency, and ensure work gets done properly across teams. This role may involve managing operations across multiple stores/pods, so we need someone who can build one strong operating system and apply it consistently across different brands when required. 

This is not a corporate COO role. We need a strong operator who can think strategically but also execute, follow up, build systems, and solve problems.



Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Operations & Execution

  -Oversee day-to-day operations across the business.

  -Track priorities, deadlines, blockers, and follow-ups.

  -Make sure tasks are completed and owners are accountable.

  -Apply the same operating rhythm across multiple stores when required.

  - Improve communication and execution between departments.



2. KPI & Scorecard Management

  -Maintain weekly KPI tracking and business scorecards.

  -Monitor key metrics such as revenue trend, MER, refunds, subscription churn, CX response time, chargebacks, inventory days, fulfillment issues, AOV, and upsell performance.

  -Ensure every KPI has a clear owner, source of truth, and action plan when off-track.



3. Customer Experience Operations

  -Track support quality, response time, resolution time, complaints, refunds, and escalations.

  -Identify recurring customer issues and create feedback loops with product, fulfillment, and leadership.

  -Help reduce avoidable refunds, complaints, and trust issues.



4. Fulfillment, Inventory & Supply Chain

  -Coordinate with fulfillment partners, suppliers, and internal teams.

  -Track inventory, shipping issues, delivery complaints, and stockout risks.

  -Escalate risks early and help create SOPs for recurring fulfillment processes.



5. SOPs, Systems & Reporting

  -Build and improve SOPs, checklists, workflows, and reporting systems.

  -Prepare weekly leadership updates showing what moved, what is stuck, what is at risk, and what decisions are needed.

  -Reduce dependency on verbal instructions and create simple systems the team can actually use.



Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  -Highly organized and detail-oriented

  -Strong with follow-up and accountability

  -Comfortable with KPIs, dashboards, and spreadsheets

  -Good at solving messy operational problems

  -Clear in communication

  -Calm under pressure

  -Hands-on, not just a delegator

  -Comfortable working directly with founders/leadership

  -Able to manage multiple departments without constant direction



Requirements

-3+ years of experience in operations, e-commerce, project management, or business management.

-Experience managing cross-functional execution.

-Experience with KPIs, scorecards, SOPs, dashboards, or reporting.

-Strong written communication and documentation skills.

-Ability to manage multiple priorities across different stores, pods, or departments.

-Comfortable using tools like Google Sheets, Slack, ClickUp, Notion, Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Klaviyo, or similar tools.

-Experience in DTC e-commerce, supplements, wellness, customer support, fulfillment, or subscription businesses is a strong plus.

-Experience managing multiple stores, brands, pods, or product lines is preferred.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  -Weekly operations are clearly tracked.

  -Department owners are accountable.

  -Important numbers are visible.

  -Fewer tasks are missed.

  -CX, fulfillment, inventory, and finance risks are caught early.

  -SOPs and systems are documented.

  -Leadership spends less time chasing updates.

  -The business runs more smoothly every week.



What This Role Is Not

This is not a pure strategy role.

   -This is not a marketing or creative role.

   -This is not a corporate COO role.

   -This is not for someone who only gives ideas but does not execute.

   -We need someone who can organize the business, follow up with people, solve operational problems, and make execution happen.

title: Funnel Page Developer — DTC Health/Supplement Brand (Replo + Liquid)
description:
We run a fast-moving DTC health brand and need a reliable contractor to build out our upsell/downsell funnel pages on an ongoing per-project basis. If you've built post-purchase funnels for supplement, telehealth, or e-commerce brands before, this is straightforward work you can probably knock out in a few hours per page.

What you'll be building

Each "funnel" typically includes:



1 long-form sales lander (hero, narrative sections, comparison table, FAQ, CTA blocks)

2–3 OTO (one-time-offer) upsell pages

1–2 downsell pages

Occasional standalone offer pages, thank-you pages, and quiz pages



All pages are built as single-file Liquid/HTML+CSS components that paste directly into Replo Custom Code blocks. Mobile-first (max-width ~480px for OTOs), responsive, no external dependencies, all styles scoped so they don't bleed into the rest of the site.

Requirements



Strong HTML/CSS — clean, hand-written, semantic. No frameworks or build tools, no Tailwind, no jQuery

Comfortable with Shopify Liquid syntax (variables, assigns, comments — we don't use complex Liquid logic)

You've worked with Replo, Funnelish, ClickFunnels, ShoGun, or similar page builders

Mobile-first design instincts — most traffic is mobile

Pixel-accurate work from reference screenshots

Vanilla JS only when needed (countdown timers, simple toggles)

Reliable turnaround and clear communication



Nice to have



Direct-response copywriting eye (you'll spot when copy doesn't fit the offer and flag it)

Experience with health/supplement compliance norms (FTC disclosures, claim language)

Light SVG/illustration skills for placeholder graphics



How we work

We send you a reference screenshot or design + the offer details (product, price, copy direction). You return a single Liquid file we paste into Replo. One round of revisions included. Variables at the top of every file so we can swap prices, URLs, and product names without touching the markup.

Compensation

Flat rate per funnel page. Bundle pricing available for multi-page funnels.

We'd like to find someone we can work with on an ongoing basis as new offers launch weekly.

To apply



Send 2–3 examples of funnel pages or landers you've built (links or screenshots)

Confirm your typical turnaround for a single OTO page and a long-form lander

Start your message with the word "bundle" so we know you actually read this

Optional but appreciated: a short note on your passions and hobbies.



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: UGC & Creator Manager
description:

KOBEES is a fast-growing beeswax-based personal care brand based in Las Vegas, USA. We need someone to own this program end-to-end — finding creators, building relationships, managing briefs, tracking deliverables, and keeping the roster active and healthy.

This is not a social media management job. You will not be posting content or running ads. Your job is to make sure we always have a pipeline of quality content coming in from creators who know our brand and can deliver fast.

This role is fully owned by you. We expect minimal hand-holding.



What You'll Do



Source and vet new UGC creators on TikTok and Instagram that fit the KOBEES brand

Reach out to creators with personalized, on-brand outreach messages

Onboard new creators — send products, share brand guidelines, answer questions

Write clear creative briefs so creators know exactly what to make

Manage the content calendar and track every deliverable from brief to delivery

Follow up consistently — you own getting content in on time, every time

Maintain a CRM or tracker with full visibility into creator status, payment, usage rights, and performance

Flag top-performing creators and recommend who to continue working with

Handle creator payments and contracts in coordination with our team

Proactively suggest new creators, new content angles, and ways to improve the program





What We're Looking For

Required:



2+ years of experience managing a UGC or influencer program for a DTC or ecommerce brand — not social media management, specifically creator/UGC coordination

Strong written English — your outreach messages and briefs represent our brand

Highly organized with a clear system for managing multiple creators and deadlines simultaneously

Proactive communicator — you chase deliverables, you don't wait to be reminded

Familiar with TikTok and Instagram — you can quickly evaluate whether a creator is a good fit



Preferred:



Experience with beauty, wellness, or personal care brands

Familiar with tools like Airtable, Notion, or similar for tracking

Has managed a creator roster of 10+ people at once

Comfortable managing small creator payments and tracking contracts





What This Job Is Not



This is not an entry-level role. We are not looking to train someone from scratch.

This is not a social media manager role. Do not apply if your experience is primarily posting content or running brand accounts.

This is not a low-effort job. We move fast and expect the same.





How to Apply

Do not send a generic application. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

In your application, include:



A brief description of a UGC or creator program you've managed — how many creators, what brand, and how you kept it organized

An example of an outreach message you've written (or would write) to a TikTok creator for a natural lip balm brand

How you would handle a creator who is two weeks late on their deliverable and has gone quiet

What tools you use to track creator deliverables and why

Client Care Specialist (Neutral Accent, Dog Lovers, 9–5 ET) — Long-Term Role



Are you a dog lover? If yes, this might be the job for you. You'll be working with US customers whose dogs are taking amazing herbal supplements and helping those customers feel cared for, every single message and every single call.



This is a long-term role. If you're great, we want you with us for years, not months. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person.



We're a small pet supplement company. Our customers are devoted dog parents, their dogs are all ages, some healthy and some dealing with health issues and they reach out to us by
, text, and phone for help. We have a strong in-house knowledge base, and we'll train you thoroughly on our products, our customers, and our process before you ever speak with a customer.



This is not a high-volume call center. We're a small, personable business where each customer gets dedicated, white-glove client care. You'll have time to actually listen, to remember a customer's dog's name from her last call, and to treat every
 and every phone call like it matters.



What you'll do

Read and reply to customer service
s

Reply to customer text messages

Help customers place orders, track shipments, and resolve order issues

Set up appointments with our head herbalist for customers who want a deeper conversation about their dog

Answer phone calls when they come in. Some days are busier than others, but whenever the phone rings, that's your first priority.



Who you are

Your English is clear with a neutral accent. Have past US customers ever been surprised to find out you weren't based in the US? If yes, please tell us about it in your application. Most of our customers are older American women (ages 40-65). They need to understand you the first time, every time.



Warm, calm, and patient on the phone. You sound like someone who could comfort a worried grandma.

A genuine dog lover. You'll be talking about dogs all day, every day — their names, their ages, their conditions, their quirks.

Kind during hard conversations. Sometimes a customer will tell you their dog was just diagnosed with something serious, or has just passed away. We don't expect you to have all the medical answers — we just want you to be kind, to listen, and to let them know you understand.

Reliable. You show up on time, you follow up, you don't drop the ball.

Comfortable with technology. You don't need to already know our specific tools — we'll train you on those. But if you do already know any customer service, e-commerce, or admin tools, please list them in your application. And if you have any other work skill that could help a small company like ours (bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, etc.), please tell us about that too.



Requirements

2+ years of customer service experience, ideally answering US customers

Reliable home internet with at least 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, and ping under 50ms, on a wired Ethernet connection (not WiFi alone). Please include a current speedtest.net screenshot showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping — and tell us in your
 what internet plan you have and whether you're on Ethernet or WiFi.



A quiet home office. No background noise on calls — no roosters, no traffic, no kids, no neighbors. Backup power or a hotspot in case of outages is a strong plus.

Quality USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone

Modern computer (Windows or Mac, less than 5 years old)

Available 9:00am–5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday–Friday. That's 9:00pm–5:00am Philippines time. Please only apply if you can genuinely commit to that overnight schedule, long-term.

ID Proof verified on your OnlineJobs.ph profile — we only review applications from ID-verified accounts.



Nice to have

You've worked for a small US-based e-commerce brand answering US customers, and those customers never realized you weren't based in the US. This is the experience we care about most.

Familiarity with any customer service or e-commerce tools (Richpanel, helpdesks, e-comm platforms,
 tools) — list anything you've used

Other work skills that could help a small company — bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well



We'll watch your video and read your application. If we like you, we'll reach out. At that point we'll ask you to obtain an NBI Clearance — we'll reimburse the fee.

Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Paid twice monthly

Long-term role — we're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person



How to apply (please read carefully — incomplete applications will not be reviewed)

In your
, please include all 6 items below. We sort applications by who followed every instruction — not by who applied first.

At the very top of your
, write the word “Buddy” in bold. (This is so we know you read all the way to the end of this post.)

Tell us in 2–3 sentences: are you a dog person? Why?



Record a 1–3 minute video covering the four prompts described below, and get it to us any way you want — attach the file, paste a YouTube unlisted link, Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, anything that works.



Attach a screenshot of a current speedtest.net result showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping. In the
, also tell us what internet plan you have at home and whether you're on a wired Ethernet connection or WiFi.



List any customer service, e-commerce, admin, or office software / tools you have used (for example: Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Google Workspace — anything you actually know).

List one or more previous employers who can speak to how good your customer service is. The more the better — but one is fine if that's all you have.



Video prompts (1–3 minutes total, single take, no editing)

Please cover all four of the following in your video, in any order you like. There's no script — just talk to us like you'd talk to a customer.



Introduce yourself. Your first name, where you live in the Philippines, and one thing about you that's not on your resume.

Tell us about your customer service background. Where you've worked, who your customers were, and — especially — what your phone customer service experience has been like. What kinds of calls did you handle? How often were you on the phone? What were your callers like?



Why this role? Tell us what you're looking for in your next job and why customer service for US pet owners feels like a fit for you.

What else can you do? Customer service is the main job — but a person with extra skills is gold to a small team like ours. If there's another work skill you have that could help our company (bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, etc.), tell us briefly about it. If customer service is your only area, just say so — that's a fine answer.



Tips:

Record in a quiet room. Audio clarity matters more than video quality.

Use your phone or webcam. We want to hear the real you.

1 minute minimum, 3 minutes maximum. Going under or over is a soft red flag — it tells us how you'd manage time on a real call.

If your application is missing any of items 1–6, or if your video is over 5 minutes or under 1 minute, we will not review it. We're being strict because we're hiring carefully — not because we don't respect your time.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Part-Time B2B SDR / Appointment Setter (SaaS / Tech Sector) – Work from Home 



About Us:

At Focalize Consulting, we help ambitious B2B software and SaaS companies scale internationally and enter new markets (like the US and Europe). We engineer high-performance outbound sales engines from scratch, turning ideas into predictable, revenue-generating systems for our clients.



As we expand our impact, we are looking for a sharp, tech-savvy Part-Time Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Appointment Setter from the Philippines to join our dynamic team.



The Role:

In this role, you will be the driving force at the front end of our outbound sales engine. You will call high-quality B2B leads in international markets (primarily the US) using our sales engagement platform Quo. Your primary objective is to handle objections professionally, build trust on equal footing, and book qualified meetings for our sales team as well as our clients.



Type: Part-Time (approx. 2-3 hours per day / max.15 hours per week)



Shift: US Business Hours (Night shift in the Philippines)



Location: 100% Remote (Work from Home)



Our Tool Stack: Quo (Sales Automation/Dialer), CSV Lead Lists, and Slack (Internal Communication).



Key Responsibilities:

Conduct outbound cold calls to B2B decision-makers (CEOs, CMOs, VPs of Sales/Marketing, CMOs, Tech Founders) in the B2B industry.



Execute structured daily calling tasks inside our sales platform Quo.



Work efficiently with CSV-based lead lists and ensure data is correctly processed within Quo.



Log clean data, call dispositions, and detailed notes meticulously into the system.



Use Slack effectively for internal communication, reporting daily KPIs, and celebrating booked meetings with the team.



Overcome gatekeepers and navigate complex corporate structures with confidence.



Qualify prospects efficiently and book discovery calls directly into our calendars.



Requirements (What we are looking for):

Experience: At least 1-2 years of proven experience in outbound B2B Cold Calling or Appointment Setting, specifically for B2B, SaaS, tech, or software companies. 



Language: Fluent, near-native Business English with a clear, professional, and easily understandable accent (US-oriented preferred). Required is a voice recording as well, if you d
 to apply to this position. 



Tech-Savvy: You must be highly comfortable working with Quo (or similar platforms like Outreach/Apollo), handling CSV files, and using Slack for daily team communication.



Mindset: A confident communicator who speaks on eye-level with corporate leaders. You are resilient, pro-active, and love the challenge of handling objections.



Workplace Setup: A quiet home-office environment, a reliable computer, a noise-canceling headset, and a rock-solid fiber internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps) with a backup solution.



What We Offer:

A competitive fixed hourly base salary (paid bi-weekly).



An attractive, uncapped bonus structure for every qualified meeting that successfully takes place (up to $50/SQL).



Working with an elite consultancy firm that provides proven sales playbooks and cutting-edge software tools.



Long-term career growth opportunities and a modern, fast-paced remote environment.

title: Creative Strategist & Copywriter
description:
Creative Strategist & Copywriter — Full Time



We're a fast-growing DTC health & supplement brand scaling native-style social

ads and video creative, and we're hiring a Creative Strategist & Copywriter to

own our creative output end to end.



This is a broad, hands-on role and we're upfront about it. You'll own

everything creative — the native ads you write yourself, the video ads you

concept and direct our editors to produce, and the landing pages you brief and

shape. Half the job is rolling up your sleeves and getting the work done to a

high standard and a fast turnaround. The other half is you driving the

strategy: bringing your own concepts, spotting what's working in the market

before we do, and proposing the angles and ideas nobody asked for yet.



We want someone who treats this brand like it's their own.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Native & written ads

- Personally write the bulk of our ad copy — you're a doer, not just a director

- Write native-style ads end to end: hook posts, planted comment threads,

  expert/doctor comments, long-form advertorials



Video creative & directing editors

- Concept video ads from scratch — hooks, angles, scripts, shot ideas, overlays

- Direct and brief our video editors: tell them exactly what to make, give

  clear creative direction, and review their cuts until they're right

- Plan video creative across UGC, avatar/voiceover, advertorial and static-to-

  video formats — and keep a steady pipeline of fresh ideas flowing to the team

- Own the iteration loop on video — what hook, what edit, what's worth

  re-cutting, what's worth scaling



Strategy & funnels

- Research and decode the winning ads (native AND video) of top brands in our

  space — find what's scaling, understand exactly WHY, adapt the best to us

- D
 on and brief new landing pages and product pages — what angle, what

  structure, what will actually convert

- Iterate relentlessly — test, read the data, scale winners, kill losers, then

  iterate again off whatever wins

- Map ads, hooks and funnels across different audiences and awareness stages

- Bring your own concepts and big ideas off your own back — we want a

  strategist who initiates, not one who waits to be handed a task

- Take on whatever the business needs — this is a do-whatever-it-takes role,

  no task is too small and nothing is "not my job"



STRONG COPYWRITER — NON-NEGOTIABLE

This role writes. You'll personally produce native posts, comment threads,

expert/doctor comments and long-form advertorials — not just brief other people

to. We need someone who can write authentic, native, scroll-stopping copy that

doesn't read like an ad, switch between voices and awareness stages, and turn

around volume without the quality dropping. If you can strategise but can't

write, this isn't the role.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A genuine hard worker — high output, fast turnaround, dependable, no chasing

- A strong writer AND a sharp visual/video thinker — comfortable owning both

- Can give editors clear, confident creative direction and hold a quality bar

- Equally comfortable executing a clear brief AND running with your own ideas

- Obsessed with DTC advertising — you study the ad libraries for fun

- A self-directed strategist who initiates rather than waits to be told

- Someone who owns outcomes, not just tasks, and takes pride in the results



This is a high-trust, high-ownership role for someone who wants to genuinely

shape a brand — not just clock in and out. The harder you work and the better

your ideas, the more rope and responsibility you'll be given. If you want a job

where you can think big, move fast, and actually see your own concepts go live

and scale across native and video, this is it.



TO APPLY

Send your CV plus 2–3 examples of work you've created — native ad copy you've

written and/or video ads you've concepted or directed (and, if you have them,

what they were modelled on or how they performed). Shortlisted candidates will

be asked to complete a short paid task — because for a role this hands-on, we

want to see how you actually think and create.

I move fast, create ideas quickly, and manage multiple companies. Your job is to help turn that vision into organized action, clear priorities, completed tasks, and consistent follow-up.

s, messages, and follow-ups

mbers, vendors, contractors, and partners

mbers

5. Light Content & Personal Brand Support

mbers

 Renewals

- Research

- Document organization

- Travel or scheduling support



The Results You Must Produce

You will be successful in this role if:

- Tasks are organized and tracked

- Important follow-ups are not forgotten

- Tea
mbers are held accountable

- Projects keep moving forward

- My calendar is clear and intentional

- My time is protected

- Loose ends get closed

- The business becomes more organized because of you

- You are measured by results, ownership, and follow-through, not just hours online.



Required Experience

You must have:

- 2+ years supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or executive

- Strong written English

- Strong organization skills

- Experience with Google Workspace

- Experience managing tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups

- Experience creating SOPs, checklists, workflows, or trackers

- Ability to think independently

- Ability to communicate clearly

- Ability to manage multiple moving pieces without falling apart

- Experience with ClickUp, Notion, Slack, Loom, Canva, ChatGPT, or social media tools is a plus.



This Role Is Not For You If

Do not apply if:

- You need to be reminded over and over

- You wait for exact instructions for every little thing

- You get overwhelmed easily

- You avoid direct communication

- You struggle with details

- You disappear when things get busy

- You only want predictable tasks

- You are working with clients already

- You rely on AI without thinking for yourself

- You treat this like “just another VA job”



I need someone who thinks, follows up, organizes, and takes ownership.



The Right Person

The right person is:

- Highly organized

- Detail-oriented

- Proactive

- Calm under pressure

- Loyal and trustworthy

- Strong at follow-through

title: Website Designer
description:
VOARVUE

Veteran-Owned  •  Premium Marine Video Production  •  Florida



NOW HIRING



Website Designer



Project-based  •  Remote  •  Client-facing builds for premium brands



The Role

VOARVUE is a veteran-owned premium video production agency. Our clients sell high-ticket assets — yachts, luxury real estate, custom builds — and we make the content that sells them.

We're expanding what we deliver. When a client signs with us, they shouldn't just get cinematic video. They should get the digital home that holds it — a website, the funnels behind it, the
 templates that move buyers through it.

That's the role. You're the designer we bring in when a client needs more than footage.



What You'll Do

- Build client websites from scratch — yacht brokerages, dealerships, luxury real estate firms, custom home builders. Premium brands selling premium product.

- Design and ship funnels and landing pages — the kind that convert serious buyers, not the templated stuff their competitors are running.

- Build branded
 templates — consistent with the site, the brand, and the way our clients sell.

- Showcase video as the hero. Our footage is the centerpiece of everything we deliver. Your design has to make it sing — autoplay reels, smooth scroll, cinematic pacing translated to the web.

- Join kickoff and review calls. You're mostly behind the scenes, but you're in the room when it matters. Clients should feel your expertise without needing to manage you.

- Move project-to-project with us. When we sign a client who needs a site, we bring you in. Steady pipeline, project-based engagements.



Who You Are

- A designer with a portfolio that ends the conversation. We don't care about credentials. We care that your past work makes us want to hire you on the spot.

- Comfortable building for video-first, premium brands. If your past sites look like SaaS dashboards, this isn't the fit. If they look like film studios, we want to talk.

- Platform-agnostic. Webflow, Framer, custom Next.js, WordPress when the client demands it — show us the tool that produces your best work. We don't have a preference.

- Fluent across the full digital stack. Sites, funnels,
. You don't need to be world-class at all three, but you can't be a liability in any of them.

- Client-ready when called on. You can sit in a kickoff with a yacht broker or a custom home builder and sound like a peer, not a vendor.

- Direct, low-ego, fast to respond. We don't do filler. Neither should you.



Bonus Points

- You've worked with marine, yacht, luxury real estate, construction, or other high-ticket verticals.

- You understand cinematic pacing and how it translates from video to web.

- You've built funnels that actually converted — and can talk about the numbers.

- You can hand off clean, maintainable files the client's team can manage without breaking them.



Structure & Pay

Project-based. When we have a client build, we bring you in. No retainer, no minimum hours — but a steady pipeline as we scale.

Propose your own pricing. Per-project flat fees, by deliverable, hybrid — whatever structure makes sense for how you work. We'd rather hear what you're worth than tell you what we want to pay.

Remote, anywhere. We coordinate on our schedule, you build on yours.



How to Apply

Two steps. That's it.

Fill out the intake form: 

Include in your submission:

- A link to your portfolio — your best 3–5 client builds, not your entire history.

- A short Loom (5 minutes max) walking us through one project you're proud of. What the client needed, what you built, what worked.

- Examples of funnels or landing pages you've designed, if separate from the portfolio.

- Your rough pricing structure for sites, funnels, and
 templates.



No cover letters. No resumes. The Loom is your interview.

title: Lead Generation Specialist - Social Media Outreach
description:
Can you get a complete stranger to respond to a cold DM?



This isn't a role for someone who sends copy-paste messages and calls it outreach. We need someone who reads the room, adapts their approach, and actually knows what it takes to get a response.



*What this job is*

We're a fast-growing eCommerce company that partners with online content creators. We have a CRM full of creators ready to be contacted — your job is to reach them across X, Instagram, Reddit, and other platforms, start real conversations, and turn those conversations into partnerships. You'll write personalized outreach, manage follow-ups, keep the CRM updated, and test new angles when current ones stop working. Simple concept, genuinely hard to do well.

- Moves without being pushed — figures things out independently, doesn't wait for direction

*One thing we need to be upfront about*

This is a full-time, dedicated role — 100% of your focus, not a share of it. We'll ask directly about other clients during interviews and expect honesty. Strong performers earn bonuses and have real room to grow. We take good care of people who do good work and want to be here long-term.



*Here's how to apply*

Read the "Who we're looking for" section above. Do those points describe you? Tell us why — in your own words, not a template, not ChatGPT. We read every application personally and can immediately tell the difference. Be specific, be honest, write like yourself.

title: Marketing and Delivery Assistant
description:
OPULENCE  DESIGNS

Delivery Coordinator + Marketing Assistant

Part-time contractor  ·  Remote, Latin America  ·  10–20 hrs/week



Role type Part-time contractor, 10 to 20 hours per week

Location Remote, anywhere in Latin America

Pay $5 to $7 per hour, based on experience

Start date Immediate, as soon as we find the right fit

Reports to Jill Johnson, Founder

Trial period 30 days

Time zone overlap Minimum 3 hours daily with Mountain Time (Edmonton, Canada)

English level B2 or higher (written, client-facing)



About Opulence Designs

Opulence Designs is a marketing and design consultancy that builds booking systems for high-end event venue owners and event planners. We work with clients running residential and commercial event businesses with budgets above $100k. Our 120-day program installs offer clarity, repositions visuals, runs follow-up sprints, and lands clients new bookings under a system they can run on their own once we step out.



I am Jill, the founder. I built this business from scratch. I run client calls, I write the strategy, I deliver the creative work, and I handle the day-to-day. Right now I am the bottleneck. I need someone next to me who can hold the system in place while I stay focused on the work that only I can do.



What this role is

You are the person who makes sure every client step gets done on time. You track where each client is in their 30-day onboarding, send the reminders, prep the worksheets, and follow up when something is sitting too long. You also help me with marketing prep, billing, scheduling, and the daily admin that keeps the business running.



This is a coordination role. The strategy is mine. The execution belongs to both of us, and your job is to keep it moving every single day.



What you will do in a typical week

A normal week sits in five buckets. Some weeks you will be heavier in one bucket than another, depending on where clients are in their phase.



1. Client delivery and SOP execution

?  Run point on client delivery across our Month 1 to Month 4 process (Onboarding, Offer Clarity, 10-Day Sprint, First Booking).

?  Track every client’s status against the SOP checklist and the Miro client journey board.

?  Send pre-call reminders, prep workbook templates, upload assets to each client’s shared folder, and confirm everything is in place 24 hours before our session.

?  Flag anything sitting longer than it should, before it slips into next week.



2. Marketing prep and content support

?  Build out content calendars in Google Sheets from my voice notes, written outlines, Loom recordings, or short briefs

?  Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft first-pass captions,
 follow-ups, short-form ad copy, and weekly content briefs from the brand voice guide. Most of this writing starts as AI output that you sharpen. You need to prompt cleanly and edit the result so it sounds like Opulence, not like Ai.



3. Billing and admin

?  Send invoices and follow up on outstanding balances through CC360 or Stripe.

?  Track payments against active contracts and flag anything past 7 days overdue.

?  Keep the client roster, contact info, contract dates, and renewal milestones current in our CRM.

?  Update Calendar and send invites to prospective clients. 



4. Scheduling and client communication

?  Schedule and confirm discovery calls, kickoff calls, weekly 1:1s, and create meeting schedule for client working sessions based on where they are at, action item focused. 

?  Respond to basic client admin questions in our shared chat (calendar links, file requests, login resets, meeting prep notes).

?  Send weekly recap notes to clients after each session, pulled from my call summaries.



5. Reporting and weekly review

?  Pull a Monday morning report on inquiries, bookings, payments, and client status so we start the week aligned.

?  Update our internal dashboard with week-over-week numbers.



Who this role is for

?  You are organized to the point that an unchecked task feels physically uncomfortable.

?  You have run admin or client coordination work before, ideally inside a creative agency, marketing firm, hospitality business, or events company.

?  You have a working command of Claude. You can write a clean prompt that gets you 80% of the way there, and you know how to edit AI output so it does not sound like AI.

?  You have a real eye for marketing and sales. You know what a good caption looks like, you can spot when a follow-up sounds desperate, you catch a typo at 50 feet, and you can tell when a subject line is going to flop.

?  You are comfortable in Google Workspace, Miro, Canva, CC360 (or a similar CRM), whatsapp, notion, and Loom.

?  Your written English is strong, B2 or higher. You will be drafting client-facing
s, captions, and reminders in English.

?  You can work 2 to 4 hours per day with a minimum of 3 hours overlapping Mountain Time, Monday through Thursday some weekend availability; Sunday meeting weekly prep call. 



Who this role is not for

?  You want to learn marketing on the job. This role assumes you already have a working eye for it.

?  You need step-by-step instructions for every task. I will give you the SOPs and the brand voice guide. You take it from there.

?  You are juggling three other clients and this is a side hustle. I need consistent presence, same hours, same days.

?  You are uncomfortable holding clients accountable to deadlines. A piece of this job is following up on people who have not returned their workbook.



Bonus points if

?  You have worked with wedding planners, event venues, hospitality groups, or boutique creative agencies before.

?  You have light video editing skills (Reels, TikTok captions, simple cuts in CapCut or Descript, basic captioning work).

?  You have used Notion for project management.

?  You have a working understanding of the wedding and events industry vocabulary.

?  You have built a content calendar from scratch for a previous client.



Tools we use

Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar), Miro, Course Creator 360, Stripe, Adobe Cloud, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Notion, and other project management tools.



You do not need expert-level skill in all of them. You need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool inside a week.



Logistics

?  10 to 20 hours per week, with room to grow as the business grows.

?  $5 to $8 USD per hour, paid every two weeks via Wise or Stripe.

?  Contractor agreement with a 30-day trial period.

?  Start date is immediate. I am ready to onboard the right person this month.

?  You bring your own laptop, headset, reliable internet, and a quiet workspace for calls.



How to apply

Send your application to 
 with the subject line: Delivery Coordinator + your first name.

Include the four items below. Applications missing the Loom or the scenario answer will not be reviewed. Apply here 
 as well. 



1.  A short Loom video (90 seconds maximum) telling me why you want this role, what kind of client work you have coordinated before, one moment you are proud of, and the kind of business owner you do your best work for.



2.  A one-paragraph answer to this scenario: A client is supposed to send back their onboarding workbook by Friday so we can run their kickoff call on Monday. It is now Wednesday and they have not returned it. Walk me through exactly what you do, what you say, and what you flag to me.



3.  The name of one tool you have used to track client work, and one sentence on what you liked or did not like about it.



4.  Your hourly rate in USD and how many hours per week you can commit.



I read every application personally. The strongest applications come from people who treat this submission the way they would treat a real client deliverable.



Jill Johnson

Founder, Opulence Designs


  ·  Refining your legacy

title: Virtual Front Desk Assistant – Regenerative Medicine Clinic + General VA Support (Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

We are Integrative Medical, a regenerative medicine clinic in the Phoenix, AZ, Metro area. We have been serving our community since 2012, and we pride ourselves on warm patient experience, efficient care, and personalized attention. Our small team values professionalism, kindness, accountability, and getting things done right the first time.



WE ARE HIRING A VIRTUAL FRONT DESK ASSISTANT

A friendly, sharp, and proactive VA to be the front-desk voice of our clinic — and to help with other projects during idle time. This is a long-term role for someone who wants stability, variety, and a workplace that values upbeat, solution-oriented people.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the first point of contact for patients calling our clinic. Between calls, you'll handle scheduling, administrative work, outreach to new patients and clients, and a rotating mix of VA tasks for other projects we run. No two days look exactly the same.



We'll provide structured onboarding, SOPs, and training on our systems — you don't need to know our specific tools on day one, but you do need to be a fast learner.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (CLINIC)

- Answer incoming patient calls professionally and warmly

- Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments

- Handle administrative tasks using office software (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, etc.)

- New patient onboarding and outreach (calls,
s, follow-ups)

- New client outreach and lead follow-up

- Other front-desk and admin duties as needed



WHAT YOU'LL DO (OTHER PROJECTS, DURING IDLE TIME)

- General virtual assistant tasks across our other business projects

- Research, data entry,
 management, document prep, light project coordination

- Whatever is needed to keep things moving — we'll always brief you clearly



This varied mix is part of the role itself. As you grow into the position and demonstrate strong performance, responsibilities and pay can expand over time.



TEAM & REPORTING

You'll be our first and only VA hire, reporting directly to the doctor. Your day-to-day interactions will primarily be with patients and other callers — you'll be the front-line voice of the clinic.



MUST-HAVES

- Excellent spoken English — clear, neutral, easy to understand on the phone

- Excellent written English — professional, error-free
s and messages

- Upbeat, cheerful, positive personality (this matters — patients can hear it)

- Proactive and solution-oriented — you spot problems and bring fixes, not just questions

- Comfortable with office software (Google Workspace and/or MS Office, calendar tools, spreadsheets, basic docs)

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, working headset, and a backup power/internet plan

- Long-term commitment — we are not looking for short-term help

- Comfortable handling confidential patient information. As a medical clinic, we operate under HIPAA. You'll be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before you start, and to follow our patient privacy protocols on every call and every record.

- Able to work US business hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (roughly 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Manila time). Please only apply if you're confident you can work and thrive on this schedule long-term.



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Prior experience in a medical, dental, or healthcare front-desk role

- Experience with US clients

- Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems, scheduling platforms, or VoIP phone systems

- Experience with CRMs or outreach tools



EQUIPMENT & TOOLS

You provide:

- A capable computer that can smoothly handle VoIP calls while running our CRM, EHR, and office software at the same time (minimum 8GB RAM, ideally 16GB; modern processor; Windows or Mac)

- An excellent noise-cancelling USB headset — clear audio quality is essential since you'll be speaking with patients

- High-speed, reliable internet (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection (second ISP or mobile hotspot)

- UPS or backup power for brownouts

- A quiet, private, distraction-free workspace — this means a home office or dedicated room. Working from a call center, BPO floor, or shared workspace is not acceptable — patients must hear only you on the line.



We provide: All clinic software and logins (EHR, scheduling, CRM), a HIPAA-compliant VoIP phone system for patient calls, training materials, and SOPs.



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (8.5 hours work + 30-minute unpaid lunch break)

- Type: Full-time (42.5 hours/week paid)

- Pay: $500–$650/month USD, based on experience

- 90-day probation period. During this time, we'll evaluate fit on both sides. After successfully completing probation, you'll receive a formal performance review, paid time off and sick leave begin accruing, and the 13th month bonus becomes effective.

- Performance-based raises after probation, with annual reviews thereafter



PAID TIME OFF (after 90-day probation)

- 10 days paid vacation per year, accruing monthly

- 5 days paid sick leave per year

- Paid time off when the clinic is closed for US holidays (you work your regular schedule on days the clinic is open)



PAYMENT

- Paid in USD, semi-monthly on the 1st and 16th of each month

- Sent via Remitly, received in your GCash wallet

- 13th month bonus paid in mid-December



START DATE

We're aiming to fill this role within 4–6 weeks of posting. We're willing to wait for the right long-term fit, including reasonable notice periods if you're currently employed.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:

1. A short message telling me why this role is a fit for you

2. Your resume / CV

3. A short video (3–5 minutes) where you:

   - Introduce yourself

   - Walk me through your work experience

   - Share your top skills and strengths

   - Share one honest weakness you're working on



To show you actually read this post, please open your application with two things:

1. Your current time zone, and confirmation you can work the hours listed above

2. One specific thing from this post that made you want to apply for this role



Applications that skip these will not be reviewed.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review (we'll respond to shortlisted candidates within 7 days of applying)

2. 15-minute video screening call

3. Paid trial task (small, paid at the hourly equivalent of the role)

4. Final interview and offer



Looking forward to meeting you!

title: Inbound Appointment Setter - Hair Salon (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
description:
ABOUT US

 

We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years.

 

Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from
 and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon.

 

This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments.

 

- Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM 
 and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel

- Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close

- Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy)

- Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar

- Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day)

- Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time

 

The most important 
nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most.

 

 

KPI TARGETS

 

This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day.

 

- Calls per day: 150 to 250

- Leads worked per day: 17 to 25

- Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher

- Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file)

- Bookings per day: 4 to 9

- Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160

 

 

WHAT I NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING

 

Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls. 



The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. I need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months.

 

Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

- 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone)

- Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day)

- Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace

- Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process

- Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used

- Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines)

 

 NICE TO HAVE

 

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone)

- Experience with Stripe payment links

- Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon)

- Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care

  

COMPENSATION

 

- Base: $900 USD per month

- Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show

- Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows

- On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month

- PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period

- Payment: Paid through 
 on a regular schedule

- Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours.

 

To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Submit a link to your updated resume  and Please send me a a cover letter explaining:

 

1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume)

2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule

3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan

4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months
