About the Role

Hair Doctors is a fast-growing Australian haircare brand launching our eCommerce store across two product ranges, a clinical hair supplement line and a Korean-formulated haircare range. 



We are building our TikTok presence from the ground up and want a specialist who has done this before, not someone learning on the job with our budget.



We are not looking for a social media manager who also does paid ads. We are looking for a performance-focused TikTok advertising specialist who understands how to turn content into sales, someone who knows how brands like Bondi Boost built exponential revenue through TikTok by combining organic credibility with paid amplification.



If you have run TikTok ad campaigns for a beauty, haircare, skincare, or consumer health brand, know how to identify winning creative before spending significant budget, and understand the full funnel from Spark Ad to Shopify checkout, this role is built for you.



Core Accountabilities

Campaign Strategy & Management

- Develop and manage our TikTok paid advertising strategy end-to-end: campaign structure, audience targeting, budget allocation, and bidding strategy

- Build and manage campaigns across all relevant TikTok ad formats: Spark Ads, In-Feed Ads, Video Shopping Ads, and Catalog campaigns

- Structure campaigns correctly from the start, awareness, consideration, and conversion objectives in the right sequence

Manage our TikTok Ads Manager account daily, monitoring performance, adjusting bids, pausing underperformers, and scaling winners

- Coordinate TikTok pixel and Events API setup with the Shopify team to ensure accurate attribution and tracking



Spark Ads Core Responsibility



- Guide our in house content creators to make well performing organic TikTok content. 

- Identify organic content from our brand account and from creator posts that has the right signals to be amplified as a Spark Ad

- Manage the Spark Code authorization process with creators, brief them correctly, obtain codes, and pull their posts into Ads Manager

- Understand what makes a Spark Ad perform versus a standard In-Feed Ad and apply that knowledge to creative selection

Build a Spark Ads pipeline, always have the next two to three pieces of content ready to test as existing ads fatigue

- Monitor Spark Ad performance at the creative level: completion rate, engagement rate, click-through rate, cost per purchase and brief creators on what is working



Creative Strategy & Briefing

- Define what creative works on TikTok for haircare and beauty products: hooks, formats, lengths, calls to action — based on platform knowledge and data

- Brief UGC creators and micro-influencers on exactly what to film: hook, key message, product demonstration, and call to action without over-scripting and killing authenticity

- Identify winning creative frameworks: before and after, routine integration, hair transformation, product unboxing, doctor-backed credibility and build a testing matrix around them

- Review creator content before it is posted and provide specific feedback aligned to TikTok best practice

- Understand the difference between content that performs organically and content that performs as a paid ad, these are not always the same

- Work with the broader team to ensure landing pages match the creative promise of the ad



Performance & Optimisation

- Set up correct campaign tracking: TikTok Pixel, Events API, and UTM parameters in coordination with the Shopify operations team

- Report weekly on key performance metrics: ROAS, CPM, CPC, CTR, cost per purchase, and video completion rate

- Run structured creative tests: test one variable at a time, gather sufficient data before calling a winner, and document learnings

- Monitor for creative fatigue and proactively refresh content before performance drops significantly

- Build a retargeting strategy: warm audiences who have viewed content, visited the store, or added to cart but not purchased

- Scale winning campaigns intelligently: know how to increase budget without killing performance



Creator & Community Coordination

- Identify and vet micro-influencers in the haircare, beauty, and wellness space who are a genuine fit for our brand

- Manage outreach, seeding, and Spark Code coordination with creators

- Build and maintain a database of creators: performance history, content quality, audience demographics, and engagement rates

- Coordinate creator relationships in a way that generates a consistent pipeline of authentic content





Who You Are



- Has run TikTok paid advertising campaigns specifically for a beauty, haircare, skincare, or consumer health eCommerce brand. This is the core requirement

- Understands the TikTok algorithm and how paid amplification interacts with organic performance

- Knows what creative works for product-based brands on TikTok. You can look at a video and tell within seconds whether it will perform or not

- Has experience with Spark Ads specifically, not just awareness of them, but has set them up, managed authorization codes, and optimized them

- Has managed a Shopify-connected TikTok campaign, understands how the pixel works, how the product catalogue integrates, and how to read attribution data

- Data-driven: you make decisions based on numbers, not feelings or aesthetic preference

- Proactive and self-directed:  you identify problems and opportunities without being asked

- Strong written English for creator briefs, reporting, and async team communication

- 3–5 years of TikTok advertising experience at a hands-on level

- Prior experience working with Australian, US, or UK clients strongly preferred





Platform & Technical Skills (Non-Negotiable)

TikTok Ads Manager

- Fully proficient in TikTok Ads Manager:  campaign creation, ad group structure, targeting, bidding, and budget management

- Has set up and managed Spark Ads campaigns. Understands the authorization process, code management, and how Spark Ads differ from standard In-Feed

- Has set up Video Shopping Ads and Catalog campaigns connected to a Shopify product feed

- Understands TikTok's campaign objectives and when to use each: Reach, Traffic, Video Views, Community Interaction,  Product Sales

- Knows how to structure a full-funnel TikTok campaign — awareness at the top, retargeting in the middle, conversion at the bottom



Tracking & Attribution

- Has installed and validated the TikTok Pixel on a Shopify store

- Understands TikTok Events API and why server-side tracking matters for attribution accuracy post-iOS14

- Can set up and validate standard events — View Content, Add to Cart, Initiate Checkout, Purchase

- Understands UTM parameter structure and how to use them to track TikTok traffic in Google Analytics or Shopify analytics

- Can read attribution data critically. Understands the difference between last-click, view-through, and blended attribution



Creative Assessment

- Can analyze a TikTok video and identify its hook, message structure, and call to action

- Understands why the first two to three seconds of a TikTok ad determine whether it lives or dies

- Knows which creative formats perform for beauty and haircare: transformation, routine, before and after, testimonial, creator reaction, educational

- Can write a creative brief that gives a creator enough direction to produce high-performing content without killing their natural voice



Shopify Integration

- Has connected a TikTok Ads account to a Shopify store via the TikTok Sales Channel app

- Understands how the product catalogue syncs and how to troubleshoot catalogue errors

- Has run Video Shopping Ads using a Shopify product catalogue

- Can coordinate with a Shopify operations team on pixel validation and event mapping





Industry Knowledge (Important)

- Understands the haircare and beauty category on TikTok: key creators, content trends, and what drives purchase intent in this space

- Has studied or worked on campaigns similar to Bondi Boost's TikTok growth strategy. Knows how organic content, Spark Ads, and Video Shopping Ads work together

- Understands the consumer journey for a beauty product purchased through TikTok,  from first view to purchase, and can build a campaign strategy around it

- Aware of TikTok content guidelines and advertising policies for health, beauty, and supplement products, knows what claims can and cannot be made in paid content





Bonus (Not Required)

- Experience managing TikTok Shop in addition to external Shopify campaigns

- Experience running campaigns for a supplement or consumer health brand

- Experience coordinating micro-influencer seeding programmes alongside paid campaigns

- Klaviyo or
 marketing knowledge to understand how TikTok acquisition feeds into retention





How to Apply

Applications without demonstrated TikTok advertising experience for a product-based brand will not be progressed.

Please include:



A specific TikTok campaign you ran for a beauty, haircare, or consumer product brand — what the brief was, what you built, the creative approach, and the results including ROAS, CPM, and cost per purchase if available

Your experience with Spark Ads specifically — how you identified content to amplify, how you managed the authorisation process, and what performance looked like

Your view on what makes creative work on TikTok for a haircare brand — what formats, hooks, and calls to action drive the best results

How you structure a TikTok campaign from scratch for a new eCommerce brand with no existing audience

Your desired daily rate in PHP and your availability

Any TikTok Blueprint certifications or relevant credentials

title: Video Editing VA - Marketing & Creative Support
description:
[Video Editing VA - Marketing & Creative Support]



We are looking for a Video Editing VA to support our marketing and creative team by turning provided product images, graphics, banners, video footage, and short copy into simple short-form videos for ads, social media, and promotional campaigns.



This is an execution-focused role. You do not need to create full video strategies, but you should be able to follow direction, edit cleanly, organize files properly, and revise quickly based on feedback from the marketing and production team.



Responsibilities

• Create short-form videos using provided product images, graphics, banners, footage, and design assets.

• Edit simple 15-60 second videos for ads, social media, and promotional campaigns.

• Add text overlays, captions, CTA, music, basic motion, and clean transitions.

• Resize and export videos for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Revise videos based on feedback from the Marketing Director, Senior Video Producer, and creative team.

• Organize project files, working assets, and final exports clearly and consistently.

• Collaborate with both the design and video production teams to execute creative requests efficiently.



Requirements

• Experience editing short-form videos for social media or advertising.

• Ability to turn static images, product photos, and provided footage into clean video content.

• Basic sense of pacing, typography, text placement, and product-focused motion.

• Comfortable following brand direction, creative references, and revision notes.

• Able to use Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools.

• Strong organization and ability to work quickly on multiple creative requests.



Application Requirements

Applicants must submit the following materials:

• Resume or CV

• Two short-form video samples with a brief explanation of your role in each sample.

• Required test assignment using the Google Drive footage and the suggested copy provided below.



Test Assignment

Download the required footage from the Google Drive link below:





Create a 10-15 second vertical short-form video using only the video footage provided in this folder and the suggested copy provided below.

• Product: Seat Covers

• Video Ratio: 9:16

• Concept: Interior Protection + Premium Upgrade



Creative Direction

• Clean, modern, and premium.

• Product should be easy to see.

• Text should be simple and readable.

• Avoid flashy effects, cluttered design, or distracting transitions.



Suggested Copy

• Headline: Protect Your Seats. Upgrade Your Interior.

• Benefit Text: Custom-fit look / Easy to clean / Built for daily driving

• CTA: Shop Seat Covers



Must Include

• Headline

• Clean footage editing

• 2-3 short text overlays

• CTA

• Background music or simple sound design



What We Will Review

• Product clarity

• Readable text

• Smooth pacing

• Clean design

• Ability to follow the requested concept and direction

• Organization and overall polish



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who can support a fast-moving marketing and creative team with clean, simple, and efficient video edits for advertising and social media content. The ideal candidate can follow direction well, make revisions accurately, stay organized, and execute creative requests quickly while maintaining a polished and premium feel.



How to Apply

Please submit your application through the V2 messaging system.

Your message must include:

• Resume or CV

• Two short-form video samples

• A brief explanation of your role in each sample

• Your completed test assignment

* Highly organized and able to follow systems.

* A positive, team-focused work environment.

* Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving company.

* Flexible working hours (aligned with AU leads).



How to Apply

 Please send the following to 

1. Your updated CV

2. A 1-minute voice recording via Vocaroo of you reading the script below (this helps us assess tone, clarity, and confidence).



Opening:

“Hi, is that [Prospect’s Name]?

It’s [Your Name] from Fitribe, how are you?”



Hook:

 “I noticed you registered for our 26-week health & fitness program, is that right?”



Purpose:

 “I’m actually the assistant to Jayde, our Head Coach. I’m just calling to help you book in time with her to go over your health & fitness goals and map out the next steps.”



Call to Action:

 “Are you free today at all? If not, the next available time I have on her calendar is [insert time]





Thank you!

title: Appointment Setter – Performance-Focused
description:
We’re looking for sharp, persistent communicators to join our outbound sales team. This is not a passive role — you’ll be making high-volume calls, engaging decision-makers, and filling the pipeline with qualified demos. If you thrive on structure, metrics, and closing the loop on follow-ups, you’ll fit right in. You'll be backed with a solid lead list, clear expectations, and a team that wants you to succeed.



Trial / Screening Period (First week):



-Compensation: Commission-only during trial

-Rate: $60 per completed demo that occurs (no-shows are not counted)

-Goal to pass: 8 completed demos within a weeks

notices small mistakes before they become problems

title: META ADS VIDEO EDITOR
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.

We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING ---

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

—
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

— UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

— AI talking-head and avatar-based ads: built using tools like HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and similar

— Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

— Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after 
nts, and social proof

— VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

— Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

— Localized creatives for new European markets as we expand



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.

We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to leverage AI to create them at scale.

You should know how to edit videos that:

— Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

— Make the problem feel real and urgent

— Show the product clearly and persuasively

— Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

— Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

— Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

— Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

— Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



--- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

This is a core part of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in:

— Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar)

— Generating AI voiceovers in multiple languages and tones (ElevenLabs or similar)

— Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough

— Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit

— Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who knows how to get the best output with the fewest wasted credits

— Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources

— Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial

If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands (beauty, skincare, or DTC is a strong plus)

— Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

— Have hands-on experience with AI generation tools (avatars, voice, b-roll)

— Can create multiple ad variations quickly

title: TECHNICAL SUPPORT ENGINEER (AI-ASSISTED TROUBLESHOOTING, INTEGRATIONS, APIs) - US HOURS | G2 AWARD-WINNING US COMPANY
description:
Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time | High-Ownership Career Role | US Hours Required



Most support roles are a dead end. This one isn't.



You're good at what you do — probably too good for where you are. You troubleshoot issues other people can't figure out. You communicate clearly when things are on fire. You take ownership of problems and drive them to resolution while everyone else is still triaging.



And you're stuck. The title doesn't match the work. The growth path is vague. The team doesn't challenge you. The company doesn't see what you're capable of.



We do.



TOKEN OF TRUST — WHAT WE DO AND WHY IT MATTERS



Token of Trust is a G2-recognized, award-winning identity verification platform. Our clients are regulated ecommerce businesses across the US who rely on us to verify real consumers, block fraud, and stay compliant — in industries where getting it wrong means legal exposure, lost revenue, or both.



When checkout verification breaks on a customer's live site at 2pm on a Tuesday, we're the team that figures out why and fixes it. We ship weekly. Our last team-wide compensation increase was three months ago. When something breaks, the whole team rallies — not because they have to, but because they care.



The engineering team builds the product. The operations team makes sure it works in the real world. This role is the technical backbone of that operations team.



THE ROLE



We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to own technical problem-solving across our product and customer integrations.



You will:



* be the first person to dig into hard technical problems — the ones that require real investigation, not just a script

* troubleshoot complex integration issues across WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, BigCommerce, and custom platforms

* devise and test workarounds for customers, then give the product team clear, actionable information on what's wrong and how to fix it

* configure and deploy our product across customer environments — and lead go-lives independently over time

* write the playbooks that make recurring issues faster to resolve and easier to delegate

* catch product issues before they reach customers through disciplined QA and regression testing

* use AI tools daily as a force multiplier — for research, troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation



This is not entry-level support. This is not a developer role. This is the kind of role where a strong technical support engineer becomes indispensable — and gets recognized for it.



You do not need to write code for this role. Developer experience helps because it gives you intuition for how systems work, but what we need is someone who can configure existing products, read what a system is telling them, and explain it clearly. The ability to understand a system matters more than the ability to build one.



WHO THIS IS FOR



You're a strong fit if you come from technical support, implementation support, support engineering, QA, or technical operations — and you want a role where your ceiling is set by your performance, not your title.



You should be:



* the person your team already escalates hard problems to

* someone who writes things down so the next person doesn't have to re-investigate

* comfortable with structured data, API documentation, and browser dev tools

* already using AI tools in your work and seeing the leverage they provide

* looking for a team that will challenge you, trust you, and give you room to grow



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Technical Support Leadership (Primary Focus)



You'll be the senior technical resource on the Operations team — the person who handles issues that require real judgment.



* triage, reproduce, and drive resolution of technical support issues

* distinguish between user error, configuration issues, integration problems, and product defects

* find workarounds for customers while permanent fixes are in progress

* gather the right evidence before escalating to Development — so engineers can act immediately, not investigate from scratch

* build and improve technical support playbooks so recurring issues can be delegated to the rest of the team

* personally drive the hardest, most ambiguous, or most business-critical issues to closure

* communicate clearly with customers and internal teams so the right people stay informed without unnecessary noise



Where This Role Grows



We're a small company, so we promise you will not get bored. Depending upon how quickly you learn, and how broad your interests, you'll be involved in other areas. As you build trust, you'll be invited to expand into spaces where your skills naturally lead, including but not limited to:



* **Go-Lives and Integration Enablement** — as the strongest troubleshooter on the ops team, you'll naturally get pulled into the most important and complex client launches. You'll configure plugins and integrations across WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, and BigCommerce. You'll join screen-share sessions with customers to resolve setup issues. Over time, you could lead go-lives independently. The core skill is configuring existing systems correctly — not writing new code.

* **QA and Release Confidence** — you'll be among the first to test cool new features, find nasty defects, tell development exactly what's wrong, validate fixes before production, and over time help automate regression testing. The goal: we catch issues before customers do.

* **Automation and Structured Operations** — you'll use AI with our APIs, logs, and structured data (JSON, YAML, CSV) and source code to investigate and confirm behavior. You'll build lightweight scripts, prompts, checklists, and internal tools that make the whole team faster. You'll help turn recurring patterns into systems so the organization gets stronger every month.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)



* you've closed your first complex escalations end-to-end and seen the impact

* you've shipped your first playbook and watched someone else use it successfully

* technical issues are reproduced faster and escalated with enough context that engineers can act immediately

* go-lives become smoother

* Development spends less time on preventable support interruptions

* leadership gets pulled into fewer emergencies because problems are caught earlier and customers are kept informed



REQUIREMENTS



* strong written and spoken English

* availability to work 8 hours per day within US hours, with US Central overlap required

* experience in technical support, Level 2+ support, QA, implementation, or a similar troubleshooting-heavy role

* familiarity with ecommerce platforms (WordPress/WooCommerce, Shopify, and/or BigCommerce)

* strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

* comfort with structured data (JSON, YAML, CSV), API documentation, and inspecting request/response behavior

* ability to write clear bug reports, technical notes, escalation summaries, and playbooks

* active daily use of AI/LLM tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) for research, troubleshooting, drafting, and analysis — and the judgment to know when to trust the output vs. verify it yourself

* strong follow-through and self-direction

* reliable internet and a professional video-call environment



PREFERRED



* experience using browser dev tools, Postman, curl, or similar debugging tools

* basic JavaScript, Python, PHP, or scripting ability — helpful for reading code and understanding systems, not required for the role

* experience validating integrations, webhooks, configuration, or data mappings

* experience with regression testing or QA process discipline



ABOUT THE TRIAL



Before a full offer, you'll complete a paid trial project working with one of our real product integrations. The trial tests your ability to install, configure, and work with an existing product — not to write code from scratch.



Strong candidates approach it like a support engineer: configure, observe, interpret, and document. Candidates who try to build custom features instead of working with the product as it ships will not pass.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



Starting at $1,100 to $1,500 USD per month depending on experience, hours, and demonstrated technical ability. This will be a combination of incentive-based and hourly pay. Paid trial project before full offer.



We are not trying to be the highest-paying listing you'll see today.



We are trying to be the best long-term bet for someone who wants to build a career, not just collect a paycheck.



This role qualifies for our Growth and Incentive Program. In 2025 alone, tea
mbers received two performance bonuses and four permanent compensation increases. You do not need to find a new job to get a raise here. As we grow, you grow — and we're growing.



We reward people who take ownership, raise standards, and deliver consistent results.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Most support roles are measured by ticket volume. You close 50 tickets, you're doing great. Nobody asks whether the 51st ticket should have existed in the first place.



This role is different. You will be valued for:



* solving real problems — not just closing tickets

* improving how the company operates

* reducing the issues that keep coming back

* creating clarity where there was confusion

* building systems and playbooks that scale beyond you



If you've been waiting for a role where your impact determines your trajectory, this is it.



HOW TO APPLY



We take hiring seriously because we are protective of our high-performing team and this is a long-term role.



It is okay to use AI to help organize or polish your application — in fact, we expect you to. But your answers should reflect your own thinking and experience.



Tell us two things:



**1. Why this role.**

In a few sentences, tell us what caught your attention about this listing and why you think this is the right next step for you. We're not looking for flattery — we want to understand what you're looking for that you're not getting now.



**2. The problem you're most proud of solving.**

Describe one real technical issue you owned end-to-end. What was the situation, what did you do, and what happened? Keep it to 5-8 sentences.



We read every serious application carefully.



If this listing described you, we want to hear from you.

**Mindset we are looking for:**

- Data-driven decision making

- Patient and methodical with testing

- Comfortable working within set processes and approval flows

- Long-term collaboration

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Working with multiple growing fashion brands

- Freedom to work from home

- Growing responsibility and autonomy based on performance

- Bonus structure once full scaling responsibility is unlocked
